devCenterName.description:

action.description: Action to perform on the DevBox: start (start DevBox), stop (stop DevBox), restart (restart DevBox), repair (repair DevBox), get-remote-connection (get RDP connection info)

tools.name: devbox_resource
tools.description:
Unified DevBox resource management tool for discovery and information retrieval.
    
Uses scope patterns to target specific DevBox resources:
- "/projects/*/users/me/devboxes/*" - List all my DevBoxes across all projects
- "/projects/projectName/users/me/devboxes/*" - List my DevBoxes in specific project
- "/projects/projectName/users/me/devboxes/devBoxName" - Get specific DevBox details
- "/projects/*/users/me/devboxes/devBoxName" - Query DevBox by name across projects

Operations are automatically inferred from scope patterns.

tools.name: devbox_think
tools.description:
Call this tool **before using any Azure Dev Center, Dev Box, or Dev Box-related tools**, including project listing, pool selection, starting/stopping a dev box, or running customization tasks. The tool provides essential context for understanding and performing Dev Box operations.
This tool outlines the core Dev Center hierarchy (Dev Center → Projects → Pools → Dev Boxes), available actions, required parameters, and common workflows (e.g., creating, connecting, or customizing a dev box). It helps ensure that all dependent tools are used correctly by grounding the model in the Dev Box domain model.

scenario.description: For connectivity issue, like I cannot connect to DevBox, I can connect to DevBox but have issues with some software, or I can connect to DevBox but have frequent disconnections, or I have high latency with DevBox, or I want to check DevBox outages, use (connectivity_issue). For general issue, use (general).

tools.name: task_resource
tools.description:
Unified Task resource management tool for DevBox task execution and monitoring.

Uses scope patterns to target specific Task resources:
- "/projects/projectName/users/userId/devboxes/devBoxName" - Run, validate, or get available tasks for a devbox
- "/projects/projectName/users/userId/devboxes/devBoxName/tasks/*" - List all task executions on a devbox
- "/projects/projectName/users/userId/devboxes/devBoxName/tasks/taskId" - Get specific task execution details/logs

Operations supported: runTasks, validateTasks, getTaskLog, listTasks, getRunnableTasks.
Operations are automatically inferred from scope patterns.
